description: This file declares the interface for the MatMulSPMDExpander class, which appears to handle tensor layout expansion and relayout logic for matrix multiplication operations within TensorFlow's DTensor MLIR expander framework.

classes.name: MatMulSPMDExpander
classes.description: A class responsible for expanding and computing tensor layouts for matrix multiplication operations in TensorFlow's MLIR DTensor framework.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Expands a tensor operation to handle layout considerations, returning a new MLIR operation related to the matrix multiplication.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes the output layout based on input layouts in a forward pass.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes the required input layouts given the output layouts in a backward pass.

methods.name: OutputLayoutAndReducedDims
methods.description: Determines the output layout and any dimensions reduced during the operation.

methods.name: MaybeRelayoutInputs
methods.description: Prepares and potentially relayouts the input tensors to facilitate local matrix multiplication, updating tensor values and layout information accordingly.
